description: Africa - Road Network is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Transport", published or maintained by Dimitris Mentis (KTH Royal Institute of Technology in Stockholm). Provided by NASA's Socioeconomic Data and Applications Centre. For details please visit. Coverage: Sub-Saharan Africa. It has 2 files in GeoJSON, SHP. The portal files it under Transport. The portal gives 2010 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
